scenario: [LCST.4.5.8]: every other string parses to null. The rule logs each string whose `::Float?` is null. Covered: NaN spellings; `inf` spellings other than lowercase `inf` (`infinity`, `INF`); leading and trailing whitespace; a unit suffix with and without `_`; a trailing or leading bare point (`1.`, `.5`, which FLOAT_LIT refuses, [LLEX.11.2]); an exponent without digits; a C hex float (`0x1p3`, which [LLEX.11.2.3] excludes); a finite spelling that rounds to infinity (`1e400`); a separator beside the point; and the empty string. PATH PINNED: FN_STRING_TO_FLOAT's runtime adapter. libds's strtod today accepts `infinity`, `INF`, leading whitespace, `1.`, `.5`, `0x1p3` and `1e400`, so this vector fails on it.
rules_ds:
schema S scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    txt: String mutable

rule absent:
    S s where (s.txt::Float?) is null
->
    log info "[{s.txt}]"
